# Avro

<!-- Generated by bazel run //tools/docs/languages:languages_bin -- --write from avro/lang.json and avro/defs.bzl. Do not edit. -->

## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//avro:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//avro:defs.bzl", "avro_library", "avro_cc_library", "avro_java_library")
```

## Rules

### `avro_library`

Owns Apache Avro schemas for dx lint.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | Avro schema files of this package. |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | avro_library targets whose schemas these import. |

### `avro_cc_library`

One C++ header with every type of the avro_library deps and their imports, and the runtime.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | avro_library targets to generate C++ for. |
| `namespace` | `string` | no | C++ namespace passed to avrogencpp. |
| `_avro_union` | `label` | no |  |
| `_avrogencpp` | `label` | no |  |
| `_runtime` | `label` | no |  |

### `avro_java_library`

Java classes for the schemas of avro_library deps and their imports, compiled once.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | avro_library targets to generate Java for. |
| `_avro_union` | `label` | no |  |
| `_avro_tools` | `label` | no |  |
| `_runtime` | `label` | no |  |
| `_zipper` | `label` | no |  |

### `avro_codegen_shard`

No documentation.

## API docs

Tool: `avro-tools`.

```python
load("@rules_dx//tools/docs/avro:defs.bzl", "avro_doc_shard")
```

### `avro_doc_shard`

```python
avro_doc_shard(name, avro, package = "", **kwargs)
```

Declares the DocIr shard of one avro_library.

Args:
  name: Name of the shard target.
  avro: The documented avro_library.
  package: Package segment of every symbol id; defaults to the name of avro.
  **kwargs: Common attributes such as tags and visibility.

Build the docs with `tools/dx docs`; see [docs](../cli/commands/docs.md).
